$comment: Scale budget (plan F4c-3). The CI scale job measures these pages on a shop starter site filled by tools/fixtures/scale.php with 5,000 products in 20 categories and 2,000 posts, search index rebuilt, WP_DEBUG off. It checks that a page costs the same with a big catalog: query counts and sizes are the measured values with about 10% headroom, and query_ms (all queries of the median run) and slowest_ms (its slowest single query) catch a query that grows with the catalog; their limits leave room for slower CI machines. A category whose products have no ratings or subcategories gets empty WooCommerce filter data, which WooCommerce stores but never reads back (FilterData::get_cache treats an empty value as a miss), so it writes those transients and its entry counter on every view until the counter reaches its cap; those writes are named in writesIgnore, and the query limits of the shop and category pages include the recount, about 40 queries on a fresh CI site (docs/DECISIONS.md, F4c-3).
